image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rough, textured rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates embedded in a hairy, leathery girdle. The plates are greyish-brown with visible growth lines and segmentation. The surrounding rock surface is speckled with small reddish encrustations.
